headline: Outcome of Board Meeting — Tata Consultancy Services Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
summary: Q2 FY27 (consolidated): Revenue ₹73,188 Cr (+11.2% YoY, +1.3% QoQ); Operating EBITDA ₹18,815 Cr (+4.7% YoY, margin 25.7%); PAT ₹13,934 Cr (+14.9% YoY, +3.8% QoQ).
raw_text: Tata Consultancy Services Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.

derivation.basis_note: Statement of Consolidated Interim Financial Results under Ind AS (PDF p. 8, reported in ₹ crore).
derivation.revenue_definition: Revenue from Operations = ₹73,188 Cr (excludes Other Income of ₹1,337 Cr).
derivation.ebitda_formula: Operating Profit (Revenue ₹73,188 Cr − Total Expenses ₹55,887 Cr = ₹17,301 Cr) + Finance Costs (₹252 Cr) + Depreciation & Amortisation (₹1,262 Cr) = ₹18,815 Cr (25.71% margin).
derivation.pbt_basis: Profit Before Tax (no exceptional items in Q2 FY27; Q2 FY26 had ₹616 Cr exceptional legal settlement provision) = ₹18,638 Cr.
derivation.pat_basis: Total Consolidated Profit for the period = ₹13,934 Cr (Profit attributable to shareholders of the company = ₹13,884 Cr; Non-controlling interest = ₹50 Cr).

enrichment.highlights: Basis: Consolidated · Normalised from ₹ crore (Page 8) · EBITDA derived from schedule iii
